vow.definition:
n. a solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner
v. make a vow; promise
v. dedicate to a deity by a vow
vow.translation:
n. 誓约, 誓言, 许愿
vi. 起誓, 发誓, 郑重宣言
vt. 立誓, 起誓要, 郑重地宣布

vowed.translation: vt.& vi. 起誓, 发誓（vow的过去式与过去分词形式）

vowel.definition:
n. a speech sound made with the vocal tract open
n. a letter of the alphabet standing for a spoken vowel
vowel.translation:
n. 元音
a. 元音的

vowel point.translation: n. 元音符号（表示元音的符号）

voweled.translation:
【语音学】
n. 元音;元音字母[参较 consonant]
a. 元音的；元音性的；元音字母的；与元音有关的

vowelize.definition: v. t. To give the quality, sound, or office of a vowel to.

vowelizes.translation: vt. 【语音学】；加元音符号于(希伯来语、阿拉伯语等文本)

vowellike.definition: s having characteristics of a vowel sound

vowels.definition:
n. a speech sound made with the vocal tract open
n. a letter of the alphabet standing for a spoken vowel
vowels.translation: n. 元音, 元音字母( vowel的复数形式 )

vower.definition: n. someone who makes a solemn promise to do something or behave in a certain way
vower.translation:
n. 发誓者, 宣誓者
[法] 发誓者, 立誓者

vowing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Vow
vowing.translation: vt.& vi. 起誓, 发誓（vow的现在分词形式）

vows.definition:
n a solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner
v make a vow; promise
v dedicate to a deity by a vow
